message: I have a friend who turns into a full-on weather reporter at the slightest hint of a storm. The other day, she texted me about a little rain cloud and I could practically hear her pacing. I reminded her that a few extra batteries and some snacks can go a long way, but she was already on her way to the store, cart full. I think she’s just preparing for a hurricane-sized snack attack! How do you all handle storm season? Do you keep it calm or join the panic parade?
